paragraphs: A Next.js landing page and live playground for Nexa AI, an assistant that drafts replies in the right tone and format for each messaging platform.

Status: app (Gmail playground connected to the AI route; Slack and WhatsApp not yet implemented) - Type: web app plus a standalone Python CLI - Visibility: public The repository name my-next-app is historical: it is the default name of a Next.js starter. The project itself is Nexa AI.

The same message needs a different voice on different platforms: a professional email in Gmail, a short bulleted note in Slack, a casual line on WhatsApp. Nexa AI is presented as one integration that adapts tone, structure and format to the channel.
features: Landing page. Sections for the hero, integrations, how it works, platform presets, playground, use cases, roadmap, core rules, FAQ and a closing call to action. The roadmap shown on the page lists Gmail as current,…
Platform presets. Gmail (professional, structured), Slack (concise, bullets and next steps), WhatsApp (casual, friendly) and Other (adaptive).

Tone playground. The visitor writes a short context, picks a platform and presses Generate. For Gmail this calls the AI route; a focus mode enlarges the playground and locks page scrolling while typing, and Done leaves…
Hero demo. An animated prompt-typing demo that needs no backend.

Action bridge. A click interceptor (ActionBridge) that maps button clicks to actions such as gmail.send. Only gmail.send is enabled, it is sent as a dry run, and the other actions (slack.post, whatsapp.send,…
